description: In just a few short months we’ll be celebrating a huge milestone in America’s history: the 250th anniversary of the United States of America. While D.C. is planning the parties and the parades, I want to be sure we honor the very foundation of our freedom.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Mast for Congress Hon
title: Freedom Isn’t Free: Making Veterans the Heart of America’s 250th Anniversary - Mast for Congress | Mast for Congress
